name: test-support-helper-use-at-possible
description: The test-support code of test-support-helper-use and one more interface, analyzed with every finding asked for. Each declaration of test-support code that test code references is reported at possible, in a component of its own, under the code a production declaration with the same references carries: the function a test and a test-file helper call and the function a test calls are reported as test-only use, and the interface one of them takes as a parameter type is reported as an unused interface whose member falls with it. An interface of test-support code nothing references is reported at certain as an unused interface, as a production one is. The tests and the test-file helper are not tests of dead code, and a production function nothing references is reported at certain.
